title: SEO & Organic Growth
description: Understand how search engines work and how to earn organic traffic. Tests keyword research, on-page optimisation, technical SEO, and content-led growth.

seo.overviewTitle: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) & Organic Growth Strategy
seo.overviewBody: SEO drives long-term organic traffic without continuous ad spend. Hiring managers seek digital marketers who can conduct technical website audits, map keyword search intent, optimize on-page content hierarchy, build high-authority backlinks, and analyze Google Search Console data.

deliverables.title: 1. Technical & On-Page SEO Audit Report
deliverables.desc: Comprehensive SEO audit analyzing indexability, meta tags, heading structures, internal links, and Core Web Vitals.

deliverables.title: 2. Keyword Research & Intent Mapping Matrix
deliverables.desc: Keyword research spreadsheet classifying search volume, keyword difficulty, and search intent (Informational vs Transactional).

deliverables.title: 3. Organic Growth Action Plan & Roadmap
deliverables.desc: Prioritized 6-month SEO roadmap outlining content creation, technical fixes, and backlink acquisition tactics.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Informational and Transactional search intent?
faqs.answer: Informational queries (e.g. 'how to fix credit score') seek knowledge, requiring educational blog guides. Transactional queries (e.g. 'buy credit monitoring software') seek products, requiring conversion-focused landing pages.

faqs.question: Why are self-referencing canonical tags important in SEO?
faqs.answer: Canonical tags inform search engine crawlers which URL is the primary authoritative version, preventing URL parameter duplicate content penalties.

faqs.question: How do you measure organic search ROI?
faqs.answer: Track non-branded organic traffic growth, keyword ranking movements in top 3 positions, and organic conversion value attributed in Google Analytics.
